set.body:
Goal: re-base GenPCA to compute THROUGH secondOrder/compress on `Op`, and DELETE the legacy numeric mirror. This is the invasive, worth-it step of Phase 1; everything else in the epic is downstream. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §8, §10 (Phase 1).

Today SemanticGenPca.fit prepares the typed diagram then drops to `legacyDiagram` + GenPca.fit — the semantic layer is a façade over a numeric engine that speaks a different vocabulary. Remove the façade:
- SemanticGenPca computes with no legacy diagram, using Op + secondOrder (S_A = Xˢ A X) + compress and a linalg solver.
- Delete MvMetric (Metric.scala), DualityDiagram (DualityDiagram.scala), MvMap/Decoder/BiProjection/CrossProjection (Maps.scala), and the raw GenPca engine path (GenPca.scala) that the façade drops into.
- Replace the six GenPCA result records with one FunctionalFrame + named accessors (from P1a).
- Delete Plans.MultivarEstimator as method identity (method constructors are the identity).

Acceptance: GenPcaRReferenceFixtures pass UNCHANGED on JVM+JS (numbers are the invariant); GenPcaLawSuite passes; no `MvMetric`/`DualityDiagram`/`MvMap` symbols remain reachable from shared production code; `sbt testAll` clean on both platforms; dependency scan confirms shared multivar imports no Breeze/dataset/image/scheduler/binding runtime.
set.title: Multivar: re-base GenPCA onto the primitives and delete the legacy MvMetric/DualityDiagram/MvMap/GenPca compute path
